request: This game has some serious gameplay issues. The physics engine is very loose, floaty and slow, and your direction ability is far too strong. Study the physics of bubble duel and emulate it. This is a very thin emulation of bubble duel, make a much more precise recreation of the original game in this shell. The most important piece of the physics engine feels fun is bouncy and rewarding. Engage in extensive iterative design and comprehensive stress testing of this among up to 50 different iterations to determine best feel and play through impact. There should also be multiple enemies. This feels like a demo as opposed to a game that can become fully flushed out at this point. Furthermore, common the location of this and the Opera house doesn't make any sense. It should be tied to the elevator.
